scope: Read-only post-render audit lane for EvidenceProse companion cards
purpose: Verify rendered-card scientific meaning with topology, materiality-first source-surface closure, card-scope control, role-partition reconciliation, and claim-bound evidence annotations.

hard_rules: Concept presence and literal queue wording are both insufficient verdict shortcuts.
Every material visual relation must be reconciled edge by edge.
Every material reader-visible content node must be dispositioned with queue scope and primary-source support.
Source-supported non-expansive elaboration may pass even when not verbatim queue text.
Source support elsewhere in the paper does not authorize sibling-specific or out-of-card claims.
Evidence annotations are claim-bound: both evidence role and visible attachment target must reconcile.

mandatory_audit_sop.name: ingest_bind_and_deduplicate
must: bind image to card_id
hash rendered image
deduplicate identical images
block ambiguous identity

mandatory_audit_sop.name: bind_primary_literature
must: bind the primary source when available
record fallback honestly
inspect source figure/table directly when a rendered relation or closed set derives from it

mandatory_audit_sop.name: build_expected_semantic_structure_and_surface_packet
must: central claims
evidence strength and causal ceiling
limitations/applicability/forbidden takeaways
protected terms/lists/categories/sequences
expected visual graph including branch conditions and terminal states
expected source-surface inventory for every material category/example/list member the source or final queue actually authorizes
expected semantic role partitions when the card compares positions
expected evidence-annotation role and attachment bindings

mandatory_audit_sop.name: blind_render_readback
must: read all visible text, numbers and citations
extract every material visual node
extract every material content node including standalone examples/categories/icons whose label carries scientific meaning
extract every material edge with source/target/direction/type/condition
extract branch points and terminal/non-terminal behavior
extract grouping/category/order/scale/colour semantics
assign stable observed_node_id to each material content node before source comparison
freeze visible evidence annotations and their apparent claim bindings
freeze material comparison/grouping role partitions
split materially mixed-support clauses into separate observed nodes before disposition

mandatory_audit_sop.name: visual_topology_reconciliation
must: disposition every observed material edge
cover every expected material relation
check source node, target node, direction, relation type, branch condition, branch parent and terminal-state continuation
check path-level implication
check text-versus-visual contradiction
never pass by concept presence alone
reconcile every material role partition/grouping
fail collapsed contrast or wrong attribution even when all words are source-supported

mandatory_audit_sop.name: source_surface_node_closure
must: disposition every observed material content node exactly once
for each node record queue authorization/scope and primary-source support with locator when supported
distinguish semantic paraphrase and source-supported non-expansive elaboration from a newly added scientific node
run explicit expansion test for source-supported non-expansive elaboration
check source-defined list membership/cardinality and card-scope boundaries
check attribution, evidence-role, numeric and citation traceability
reconcile every material evidence annotation by role and visible claim binding
forbid topic-plausibility and literal queue-whitelist shortcuts
split mixed-support clauses before disposition and repair the smallest failing segment

material_failure_rules.MATERIAL_QUEUE_PROTECTIVE_LOCK_VIOLATION: FAIL_RENDER only when the lock has explicit material scientific protective purpose
material_failure_rules.source_supported_nonexpansive_elaboratio: PASS when explicit no-expansion test passes

mandatory_audit_sop.name: derive_per_card_verdict
mandatory_audit_sop.rule: PASS is illegal unless both topology closure and source-surface node closure are complete and all substantive axes pass.

mandatory_audit_sop.name: cross_card_and_package_audit
must: cross-card contradictions
evidence-role drift and annotation binding drift
taxonomy drift
scope expansion
sibling semantic bleed
package limitation coverage
cross-card source-surface additions

mandatory_audit_sop.name: repair_and_human_display
must: every FAIL_RENDER/FAIL_SPEC gets executable repair ticket
repair smallest failed region
substantial structural/content change gets supported replacement material
project all failed-card repair instructions into exactly one writing block

source_surface_gate.material_node_definition: Any reader-visible claim, number, category, example, mechanism, population, context, outcome, citation, evidence annotation or relationship whose presence or placement can change scientific understanding.
source_surface_gate.materiality_first_rule: Literal queue mismatch is not itself a material scientific failure.
nonexpansive_elaboration_requirements: attaches to an already authorized semantic parent
adds no new claim/category/closed-set member/number/population/scope/mechanism/causal relation/clinical implication
violates no queue lock with material scientific protective purpose
source_surface_gate.evidence_annotation_rule: Every material evidence marker must reconcile both evidence role and visible claim binding.
source_surface_gate.mixed_clause_rule: Split clauses before disposition when materially different support or scope would otherwise be merged.
closure_rules: Every observed material node appears exactly once in content_node_checks.
Every expected source-defined closed-set member appears exactly once in expected_content_checks.
Every material evidence annotation is checked for role and binding.
Scientific plausibility and support from adjacent literature do not satisfy bound-source support.
Support elsewhere in the same paper does not automatically authorize out-of-card or sibling-specific content.
Literal visible_text/no_unlisted_visible_text mismatch does not by itself create FAIL_RENDER.

verdicts.PASS: all substantive axes pass; topology, role-partition, source-surface and evidence-annotation closure are complete
verdicts.PASS_WITH_WARNINGS: only non-material deviations remain, including harmless duplicate labels or engineering-only wording divergence
verdicts.FAIL_RENDER: sound expected science/spec, but render materially changes meaning, topology, role partition, card scope, evidence-role binding, source structure or traceability
verdicts.FAIL_SPEC: render faithfully reflects a materially wrong upstream spec/truth/source binding
verdicts.BLOCK_UNVERIFIABLE: material source/identity/render relation cannot be checked without guessing

regression_cases.C02_WRONG_BRANCH_SOURCE: Retained from v1.0: wrong branch parent must FAIL_RENDER even when labels are correct.
regression_cases.C02_PLAUSIBLE_UNSOURCED_CATEGORY: If a card about narrow attachment-and-sex research adds 'pregnancy/postpartum context' as a research-gap category while the final queue did not authorize it and Dewitte 2020 does not support it, the card must FAIL_RENDER. The fact that pregnancy/postpartum is plausible or relevant in the wider attachment literature is irrelevant to this bound-source audit.
regression_cases.ROESLER_C04_C05_SUPPORTED_NONEXPANSIVE_G: Source-supported explanatory gloss within the same authorized semantic node must not fail solely because it is not verbatim visible_text.
regression_cases.ROESLER_C06_COLLAPSED_CONTRAST: Repeating the same two-sided sentence under both comparison boxes is FAIL_RENDER because placement collapses the intended semantic partition.
regression_cases.ROESLER_C09_SIBLING_SEMANTIC_BLEED: Source-supported therapeutic-relationship content imported into the SDA card is out-of-card scope and FAIL_RENDER.
regression_cases.ROESLER_C10_EVIDENCE_ROLE_DRIFT: A CONFLICT marker on a GAP-only child-motif card is FAIL_RENDER.
regression_cases.ROESLER_C01_EVIDENCE_BINDING_DRIFT: A valid CORE marker attached to each theory category fails when the evidence role is not authorized at that claim granularity.
regression_cases.ROESLER_C03_DIRECTIONAL_SPECULATION: A directional arrow replacing an unordered speculative bridge remains a topology FAIL_RENDER.
regression_cases.ROESLER_C05_HARMLESS_DUPLICATE_LABEL: A redundant duplicate label that changes no evidence binding or weight is warning-only.

human_repair_display.ordinary_chat_rule: Outside the writing block, report only verdict/count/card-id summary; do not duplicate the repair body.
